title: Solution-Architect Eval Case
description: One held-out eval case for the solution-architect advisory persona: a structural-review input paired with its expected ADR-alignment decision. Each line of evals/solution-architect/<split>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape. The persona measures a change against the recorded ADRs and cites the governing one, so the expected decision is ADR-shaped (risk_tier / escalate / cite_adr / recommend) — NOT the triage {escalate, risk} shape of evals/case.schema.json. This is the trust anchor for the persona's skill-quality measurement and is CODEOWNER-gated separately from any scorer/proposer.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case (e.g. 'sa-dev-frozen-tag-pin'). Unique within a split and disjoint across dev/holdout (enforced by evals/validate-cases.py).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises and which ADR grounds the expected decision (or why no ADR governs).

tags.description: Optional labels for coverage tracking, e.g. the ADR a case exercises ('adr-0002', 'no-adr', 'structural-drift', 'negative').

input.description: The pre-fetched structural-review context exactly as the advisory consumes it: a self-contained description of the proposed change under review.

expected.description: The fixed, reward-hack-resistant expected structural advisory the persona must produce for this change.

risk_tier.description: Expected structural risk classification. Any HIGH signal must pair with escalate=true.

escalate.description: Whether the advisory must flag the change for escalation (true) or may say no escalation is warranted (false).

cite_adr.description: The governing ADR the advisory must cite by number (e.g. 'ADR-0002'), or the literal 'none' when no recorded ADR governs the change — the load-bearing 'say so rather than invent doctrine' case.

recommend.description: The structural recommendation the advisory must land, grounded in the cited ADR (or in naming the ADR gap when cite_adr is 'none').
